blurb: National Helicopters offers aerial tours over Niagara Falls, custom charters, and professional helicopter maintenance services. Their Niagara Falls tours include a 20-minute flight with views of the Niagara River, Whirlpool Rapids, Rainbow Bridge, and both American and Canadian Horseshoe Falls. They also provide executive charters, aerial photography, heli-golf packages, and utility and contract flight services.
extraNote: Flights can be rescheduled or cancelled for a full refund with minimum 48 hours notice · Flights cancelled only for low cloud coverage, lightning, heavy rain or snow reducing visibility · Bolton Heliport, 11339 Albion Vaughan Road, Kleinburg, Ontario
